description: This file defines the One2OneRelationship class, representing a one-to-one relationship in the SuiteCRM system. It extends the M2MRelationship class and provides methods for adding relationships, ensuring existing links are removed before establishing a new one.

classes.name: One2OneRelationship
classes.description: Represents and manages a one-to-one relationship in the CRM, handling the addition of linked records with proper cleanup of existing links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the relationship with given definitions by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two SugarBean objects, removing existing links from both sides beforehand to maintain one-to-one integrity.
